title: Saquon Barkley back to full participation, Hollywood Brown doesn't practice

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Saquon Barkley back to full participation, Hollywood Brown doesn't practice
sources.description: Eagles running back Saquon Barkley said that he expects to be good to go for Monday night's game against the Bears and Friday's injury report shows that he's on track to play.
